semantic.implementation: Render the world title, supporting text and primary action as semantic HTML headings, paragraphs and buttons above WorldArtwork. Position these in the bottom scenic area; code owns a navy contrast scrim wherever the actual text overlap requires it, especially neon.
semantic.notes: Do not bake text or CTA graphics into an illustration. Test rendered text contrast and preserve accessible button labels.

semantic.implementation: WorldArtwork should render an img with 640w and 1122w srcSet, route-appropriate sizes, explicit intrinsic width/height, object-fit: cover, and a deliberate object-position. CSS owns radius, clipping, frame, border, shadows, layout and any transform. Preserve the scene's main landmark and small traveller in hero crops; use the same raster family for book covers.
semantic.notes: No crop or presentation chrome is baked into the files. Above-the-fold hero may load eagerly; offscreen covers should lazy-load. UI screenshot QA belongs to the builder.
